name: mess-pass
description: 100% offline-first mobile web app for managing daily mess QR coupons

scripts.cap:sync: astro build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:install: npm run cap:sync && cd android && APP_VERSION_NAME=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) APP_VERSION_CODE=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.android:verify: bash -c 'APK=android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk; APKSIGNER=$(ls -1 ${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/build-tools/*/apksigner 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1); if [ -n "$APKSIGNER" ]; then "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK"; else keytool -printcert -jarfile "$APK"; fi'
